3cd4f0e4c1d7619d.description:
hoichoi is India's leading Bengali OTT platform — the digital arm of SVF, Eastern India's largest media & entertainment company. We stream 650+ Bengali movies, 185+ originals, and 3000+ hours of content to a global audience of ~250 million Bengalis across India, Bangladesh, and 100+ countries. We're part of a wider ecosystem alongside Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT) and LoglineAI (AI-native creative studio), and we're on a mission to entertain everyone in their native language.

The Opportunity
We're hiring a Senior Product Analyst to become the first dedicated owner of product analytics at hoichoi. We've been running PostHog for a few months, with real event data flowing across all platforms — what's missing is someone who digs into the data unprompted and turns it into a clear case for what we should change, and why. You'll sit inside the Product & Data team and work closely with Engineering, Payments, and Programming to move two numbers: revenue and user experience.

This is not a reporting service desk. As the first dedicated hire in this function, you will define how it works rather than inherit it. Your output is decisions, not dashboards — finding the exact step where a subscriber drops off, and owning a recommendation through to whether the number actually moved. We want someone who's done this before, checks the data before forming a view, and is comfortable reporting a flat result honestly. This is a full-time, in-office role based in Kolkata.

What You'll Do

Drop-off Analysis
• Map every meaningful journey on every platform and find the exact step where users leave: onboarding, login and signup, search, content discovery, playback start, and the subscription funnel.
• Own the subscription funnel end to end — app open → paywall viewed → plan selected → payment initiated → payment success — split by platform, geography, and payment method.
• For every drop-off found, report how many users and how much revenue it costs, why it's happening, and what specifically should change.
• Analyse payment failures and retry behaviour alongside the payments team.
• Track whether each recommended fix moved the number, and report plainly if it didn't.
Retention, Churn & Cohorts
• Build and maintain retention and cohort views — day-1/7/30, trial-to-paid, renewal, and cancellation.
• Identify first-session and first-week behaviours that predict a subscriber sticking around, and recommend how to engineer more of them.
Content & Programming Analytics
• Report on content performance — tray impressions and clicks, play starts, completion rates, drop-off curves, and search behaviour.
• Feed insights back to the programming team on what to promote, tray order, and whether an underperforming release was a content or merchandising issue.
• Support the internal Programming Analyst tooling built on top of PostHog.
Experimentation
• Set up and read A/B tests and feature-flag rollouts in PostHog — paywall variants, onboarding flows, tray layouts.
• Define success metrics and guardrail metrics up front, and call results honestly, including flat ones.
Reporting Rhythm
• Run a weekly product metrics review that people actually read, and a monthly deep dive on one problem area of your choosing.
• Deliver release-impact analysis after every major app release.

Must-Have Qualifications :
• 4–6 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or data analysis on a consumer (B2C) product — app or web — including experience mentoring or setting standards for others.
• Hands-on ownership of a product analytics tool (PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap, or similar) — has defined events, built funnels, and debugged bad data, not just consumed dashboards someone else built.
• Demonstrated ability to find drop-offs and act on them, with a concrete example of a funnel fixed, what was found, what changed, and what it was worth.
• Solid grasp of funnels, cohorts, retention curves, and segmentation.
• Comfortable working with AI tooling day to day — specifically the PostHog MCP server with Claude — and able to get MCP running within a week if new to it.
• Willing to check the data and then take a decision: form a view, recommend it clearly, and own the outcome.
• Able to write a clear recommendation — what the data says, what to do about it, and how confident to be.
• Self-directed, arriving with questions rather than waiting for answers.

Candidates must have experience in any product analytics tool: PostHog, Mixpanel, Amplitude, CleverTap or similar. 

Why Join hoichoi
You'll be the first dedicated product analytics hire at India's leading Bengali OTT platform — defining how the function works rather than inheriting someone else's playbook, with real event data across six platforms from day one. Every recommendation you make has a direct line to revenue and to how millions of viewers experience the product. hoichoi is going all-in on becoming AI-native, so you'll work daily with the PostHog MCP server and Claude as part of your core workflow, with a clear path to owning a growing analytics function as it scales.

Culture & How We Work
At hoichoi, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams that argue productively and ship fast. Ownership isn't a buzzword here; it's the default setting — if something's broken, you fix it rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Some releases — particularly TV platform and store submissions — land outside standard hours, and we expect flexibility around those windows. We're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable the rest of the time.

Headquarters: Remote

About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company with an unusually large organic top-of-funnel, where tens of thousands of people discover and sign up for Netlify every day. That organic motion is real and meaningful, but paid acquisition is a new investment area for the marketing team, and there's a clear opportunity to build that capability from the ground up. 

As Senior Manager, Demand Generation & Performance Marketing, you'll own paid acquisition end to end - strategy, channel selection, budget, and the agency relationship that supports execution. You'll report to the CMO, with a planned transition to the VP of Growth Marketing as that function scales, and work closely with Marketing Operations, Data, Lifecycle, and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users don't just land, but convert and stick. This is a builder role at a company where the organic foundation is already strong, and your job is to build the paid layer that extends its reach.

What You'll Do

• Build and own Netlify's paid acquisition strategy end to end, including paid search, paid social, retargeting, sponsorships, and any other channels worth testing and proving out. 

• Own the call on where paid creates incremental value for Netlify. Design the tests, prove which channels and audiences drive growth our organic funnel wouldn't have delivered anyway, and decide where to scale, where to hold, and where not to spend at all.

• Manage the agency relationship(s) supporting paid/performance work by setting the brief, holding the agency accountable to targets, and deciding what to bring in-house as the function matures.

• Own budget planning, pacing, and ROI reporting for all paid spend, and make the case for where to double down or pull back.

• Partner with Marketing Operations to get attribution and UTM tracking right before scaling spend, so every dollar is measurable.

• Define target audiences and channel mix aligned to Netlify's ICP; partner with Product Marketing on messaging inputs for paid creative.

• Build the measurement framework for CAC, signup/pipeline contribution, and payback by channel.

• Partner with Lifecycle and Campaigns to make sure paid-acquired users flow into the right onboarding and activation journeys, not just land and drop off.

• As the program proves out, build the roadmap and case for a fully staffed paid/performance team.

What You'll Bring

• 6+ years in demand generation or performance marketing, with direct ownership of a paid acquisition budget in a B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment

• Hands-on experience running paid search, paid social, and retargeting programs yourself - not just briefing agencies or reviewing their reports

• A track record of standing up or significantly scaling a paid acquisition program at an early stage, where you had to build the infrastructure and not just optimize what was already there

• Experience managing an external agency or partner relationship, including setting performance expectations and holding partners accountable to them

• Working knowledge of attribution and marketing measurement, and a history of partnering with Marketing Ops or Data teams to get tracking right before spend scales

• Some experience marketing to developers or technical audiences, or with a PLG motion where paid acquisition runs alongside a large organic and self-serve funnel

This Role Is a Great Fit If

• You're energized by building and scaling a new paid program, not just optimizing one that's already mature.

• You think like an owner of budget and outcomes, not just a briefs-and-reports manager of an agency.

• You're comfortable moving between strategy (channel mix, targeting, budget allocation) and getting into the details yourself when it matters.

• You care about attribution being right before spend scales, not as an afterthought.

• You want to build in close partnership with Lifecycle, Campaigns, and Marketing Ops rather than run paid as a separate lane that hands off a spreadsheet at the end of the quarter

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include: 

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. 

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com. 

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $150,000 - $200,000  for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-demand-generation-marketing-manager

About Clearwater Analytics:

Clearwater Analytics, global industry-leading SaaS solution, automates the entire investment lifecycle. With a single instance, multi-tenant architecture, Clearwater offers award-winning investment portfolio planning, performance reporting, data aggregation, reconciliation, accounting, compliance, risk, and order management. Each day, leading insurers, asset managers, corporations, and governments use Clearwater’s trusted data to drive efficient, scalable investing on more than $6.4 trillion in assets spanning traditional and alternative asset types.

Our mission: To be the world’s most trusted and comprehensive technology platform that simplifies the entire investment lifecycle and eventually revolutionizes the world of investing.

Job Summary: 

As a hands-on Data Engineer at Clearwater Analytics (CWAN), you will turn business and platform data into actionable insights that drive decision making. You will use Python and SQL to extract, clean, and analyze data, and contribute to building the data pipelines that feed your dashboards and analysis. You will build dashboards and reports, analyze key business and platform performance metrics, and work closely with cross functional teams to understand their data and reporting needs.

Responsibilities And Duties

• Analyze business and platform performance metrics to surface trends, risks, and opportunities for stakeholders
• Contribute to building and maintaining data pipelines that feed dashboards, reports, and analytical tools
• Write Python and SQL to extract, clean, transform, and analyze data from various sources
• Build and maintain BI dashboards and reports (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) that make data and business metrics easy to understand and act on
• Partner with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and other cross functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into meaningful analysis and reporting
• Support the wider business with ad hoc data and reporting requests
• Identify data quality issues and partner with engineering teams to help resolve them
• Document metrics definitions, data sources, and reporting logic to ensure consistency and clarity across teams
• Continually look for opportunities to improve analytical workflows and reporting processes

Required Skills

• Strong hands on proficiency in Python for data processing, analysis, and automation is required
• Proficiency in SQL and deep knowledge of various data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift)
• Solid understanding of business and platform related metrics, with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights
• Experience building dashboards and reports using BI/data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
• Experience building or contributing to data pipelines that support analytics and reporting
• Strong analytical and problem solving skills
• Familiarity with data governance principles and data quality best practices
• Experience in the finance industry will be a significant advantage
• Experience utilizing ETL tools and technologies such as DBT, Fivetran, ADF, SSIS is a good to have
• Exposure to GenAI/LLM technologies (e.g., prompt engineering, LLM-based data processing, RAG pipelines) is a good to have

Education And Experience

• Degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, or a related field
• 3 - 7 years of hands-on experience in data analysis, reporting, or business intelligence, with a track record of turning data into business insights
